acceptable_claims.qualification: Reported direction and uncertainty only; no conclusive benefit.
acceptable_claims.text: A1 reports 18/40 versus 12/40 responses at six weeks, with an interval spanning no difference.
A2 reports 20/50 versus 21/50 responses and no clear difference.

contrary_interpretation: A2 is contrary to an unqualified claim of established benefit; it does not contradict A1’s literal reported counts.
expected_partial_outcome: Report explicitly stated abstract facts, describe mixed and imprecise evidence, and leave unreported methods/adverse events unknown.

illustrative_disagreement.illustrative_resolution: Accept the reported direction as a qualified finding; reject a conclusive benefit claim. No independent reviewer has signed this example.
illustrative_disagreement.position_a: A1 has a favorable reported direction.
illustrative_disagreement.position_b: Its interval and A2 do not establish benefit.

severe_error_examples.description: Declare established benefit from A1 while hiding A2 and the interval.
Invent adverse-event or subgroup results from inaccessible full text.

unresolved_reference_gaps: No full-text methods or adverse-event table in this packet.
